PHYSICAL EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: PHYSICAL EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Overview of Hiking ● Types of hiking ● Essential hiking gear: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Overview of Hiking ● Types of hiking ● Essential hiking gear.
   B. Practise Overview of Hiking ● Types of hiking ● Essential hiking gear with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Overview of Hiking ● Types of hiking ● Essential hiking gear.
   D. Damage equipment used for Overview of Hiking ● Types of hiking ● Essential hiking gear.

2. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)

   B. The ticket price
   C. Only the costume
   D. The speed of the music

3. Best practice when working on Volleyball: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Volleyball.
